title: A transient fetch failure of an auto-load marketplace is never retried, so the conversation permanently loses its plugin skills and hooks
body:
_This issue was created by an AI agent (OpenHands) on behalf of @neubig._ ## Summary When an `auto_load` marketplace cannot be fetched the first time a conversation loads plugins, `LocalConversation` skips it for the rest of that conversation object's life. Nothing retries it. A short git-host failure (for example an HTTP 503 during `git clone`) therefore removes the marketplace's plugin skills, hooks, sub-agents and MCP servers from the conversation for good, even after the git host is back a second later. Only a new `LocalConversation` instance (for example after an agent-server restart) tries again. The fetch layer also drops the git error. So a transient failure (503, connection reset, DNS) and a permanent one (404, missing credentials) produce the same message, and no caller can tell them apart. ## Impact - The conversation keeps running without the configured marketplace capabilities. Policy hooks (`PreToolUse`, `Stop`, ...) from the marketplace's plugins are not installed, so they do not run. Marketplace skills and sub-agents are missing. - The user gets one `MarketplaceLoadError` `ConversationErrorEvent` (added in #6460). Its detail only says `Failed to fetch plugin from `. It does not say whether the failure was transient. The detail also does not say that the marketplace will not be retried. - Sending more messages does not help. In the agent server, the `LocalConversation` stays in memory for the whole conversation, so the capabilities stay missing until the server process restarts. - A cold cache makes this most likely, because a failed `git clone` has no cached copy to fall back on. A fresh sandbox always starts with a cold cache. With a warm cache, a failed `git fetch` already falls back to the cached copy ([`_try_fetch`](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/git/cached_repo.py#L1065-L1072)). ## Root cause 1. **The load runs once per object, whatever the result.** `_ensure_plugins_loaded()` returns early once `_plugins_loaded` is set ([L1169-L1170](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/conversation/impl/local_conversation.py#L1169-L1170)). The flag is set at the end of the method in all cases, including when a marketplace was skipped ([L1568](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/conversation/impl/local_conversation.py#L1568)). It is reset only in `__init__` ([L414](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/conversation/impl/local_conversation.py#L414)). 2. **A failed marketplace is skipped with no retry and no record.** ([L1243-L1261](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/conversation/impl/local_conversation.py#L1243-L1261)) ```python for registration in registry.get_auto_load_registrations(): try: marketplace, marketplace_path = registry.get_marketplace(registration.name) except Exception as exc: logger.warning("Failed to load marketplace '%s'; continuing without it", ...) self._emit_auto_load_error("MarketplaceLoadError", ...) continue ``` Nothing stores which registrations failed, so a later `send_message()` / `run()` has nothing to retry. 3. **The fetch path makes one attempt only.** `MarketplaceRegistry._fetch_marketplace` calls `fetch_plugin_with_resolution` once ([registry.py L194-L216](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/marketplace/registry.py#L194-L216)). That ends in a single `git clone --depth 1` ([cached_repo.py L976-L992](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/git/cached_repo.py#L976-L992)). No layer has a retry or backoff. 4. **The fetch layer discards the reason for the failure.** `try_cached_clone_or_update` catches `GitCommandError` (and lock `Timeout`), logs it, and returns `None` ([cached_repo.py L910-L920](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/git/cached_repo.py#L910-L920)): ```python except GitCommandError as e: logger.warning(f"Git operation failed: {e}") return None ``` The caller then raises a generic error with no cause ([extensions/fetch.py L299-L302](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/extensions/fetch.py#L299-L302)): ```python if result is None: raise ExtensionFetchError(f"Failed to fetch extension from {redact_url_credentials(source)}") ``` So `git`'s `The requested URL returned error: 503` and `... returned error: 404` reach the conversation as the same text. A caller cannot classify the failure as retryable. The repro below also shows that `load_plugin()` succeeds in the same conversation once the host is back. `load_plugin()` builds a fresh `MarketplaceRegistry` ([L1935-L1938](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/conversation/impl/local_conversation.py#L1935-L1938), [L1593](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/conversation/impl/local_conversation.py#L1593)). So the source works again, but the auto-load path never asks for it again. ## Reproduction The test serves a real git repository through a local git smart-HTTP server (`git http-backend` behind `http.server`). The only stubbed boundary is the git host: it answers `503` while `upstream_down` is set, which is what `git clone` sees during a short git-host outage. No SDK code is mocked. ```bash # from a checkout of main uv sync --dev T=$(mktemp -d) # isolated HOME / plugin cache = cold cache, like a fresh sandbox HOME=$T/home OH_PERSISTENCE_DIR=$T/oh OPENHANDS_SUPPRESS_BANNER=1 \ uv run pytest /tmp/test_marketplace_transient_failure.py -s -q -p no:cacheprovider ```
/tmp/test_marketplace_transient_failure.py ```python """A transient failure while fetching an auto-loaded marketplace is never retried. The marketplace is a real git repository served by a local git smart-HTTP server (``git http-backend``). While ``upstream_down`` is set the server answers 503, which is what ``git clone`` sees during a short git-host outage. Nothing in the SDK is mocked. """ import json import subprocess import threading from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer from pathlib import Path from pydantic import SecretStr from openhands.sdk import LLM, Agent, AgentContext from openhands.sdk.conversation.impl.local_conversation import LocalConversation from openhands.sdk.event.conversation_error import ConversationErrorEvent from openhands.sdk.marketplace import MarketplaceRegistration def _git(*args: str, cwd: Path) -> None: subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True) def _make_marketplace_repo(root: Path) -> Path: src = root / "src" plugin = src / "plugins" / "policy" (plugin / ".plugin").mkdir(parents=True) (plugin / ".plugin" / "plugin.json").write_text( json.dumps({"name": "policy", "version": "1.0.0", "description": "d"}) ) (plugin / "skills").mkdir() (plugin / "skills" / "policy-skill.md").write_text( "---\nname: policy-skill\n---\nFollow the policy." ) (plugin / "hooks").mkdir() (plugin / "hooks" / "hooks.json").write_text( json.dumps( {"hooks": {"PreToolUse": [{"matcher": "*", "hooks": [{"command": "true"}]}]}} ) ) (src / ".plugin").mkdir() (src / ".plugin" / "marketplace.json").write_text( json.dumps( { "name": "team", "owner": {"name": "t"}, "plugins": [{"name": "policy", "source": "./plugins/policy"}], } ) ) _git("init", "-q", "-b", "main", cwd=src) _git("add", ".", cwd=src) _git("-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@t", "commit", "-qm", "init", cwd=src) served = root / "served" served.mkdir() _git("clone", "-q", "--bare", str(src), str(served / "market.git"), cwd=root) return served def test_transient_marketplace_failure_is_never_recovered(tmp_path: Path): served = _make_marketplace_repo(tmp_path) state = {"upstream_down": True, "requests_while_up": 0} class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): """Minimal git smart-HTTP server (CGI bridge to git http-backend).""" def _serve(self): if state["upstream_down"]: self.send_error(503, "upstream temporarily unavailable") return state["requests_while_up"] += 1 path, _, query = self.path.partition("?") body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)) env = { "GIT_PROJECT_ROOT": str(served), "GIT_HTTP_EXPORT_ALL": "1", "REQUEST_METHOD": self.command, "PATH_INFO": path, "QUERY_STRING": query, "CONTENT_TYPE": self.headers.get("Content-Type", ""), "CONTENT_LENGTH": str(len(body)), "HTTP_GIT_PROTOCOL": self.headers.get("Git-Protocol", ""), } out = subprocess.run( ["git", "http-backend"], input=body, env=env, capture_output=True ).stdout head, _, payload = out.partition(b"\r\n\r\n") status = 200 headers = [] for line in head.decode().split("\r\n"): key, _, value = line.partition(": ") if key.lower() == "status": status = int(value.split()[0]) else: headers.append((key, value)) self.send_response(status) for key, value in headers: self.send_header(key, value) self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload))) self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(payload) do_GET = do_POST = _serve # noqa: N815 def log_message(self, *args): pass server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler) threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start() url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_address[1]}/market.git" workspace = tmp_path / "ws" workspace.mkdir() agent = Agent( llm=LLM(model="test/model", api_key=SecretStr("k")), tools=[], agent_context=AgentContext( registered_marketplaces=[ MarketplaceRegistration(name="team", source=url, auto_load=True) ] ), ) conversation = LocalConversation(agent=agent, workspace=workspace, visualizer=None) # 1) First message while the git host is briefly unavailable. conversation.send_message("first") error_events = [ e for e in conversation.state.events if isinstance(e, ConversationErrorEvent) ] errors = [e.code for e in error_events] print("\nerrors after first message:", errors) print("error detail:", error_events[0].detail) # 2) The git host recovers; the same conversation keeps receiving messages. state["upstream_down"] = False conversation.send_message("second") conversation.send_message("third") assert conversation.agent.agent_context is not None skills = [s.name for s in conversation.agent.agent_context.skills] hooks = conversation.state.hook_config print("git requests after the host recovered:", state["requests_while_up"]) print("skills:", skills) print("hook_config:", hooks) # The source is reachable again from this same conversation: an explicit # load_plugin() builds a fresh MarketplaceRegistry and succeeds. conversation.load_plugin("policy@team") print( "after explicit load_plugin('policy@team') -> skills:", [s.name for s in conversation.agent.agent_context.skills], ) conversation.close() server.shutdown() assert errors == ["MarketplaceLoadError"] assert "policy-skill" in skills, "auto-loaded plugin skill never recovered" assert hooks is not None, "auto-loaded plugin hooks never recovered" ```
Observed output on `main` at `af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b` (log lines trimmed): ``` errors after first message: ['MarketplaceLoadError'] error detail: Marketplace 'team' (http://127.0.0.1:39993/market.git) could not be loaded, so its plugin skills, agents and hooks are unavailable: Failed to fetch plugin from http://127.0.0.1:39993/market.git git requests after the host recovered: 0 skills: [] hook_config: None after explicit load_plugin('policy@team') -> skills: ['policy-skill'] E AssertionError: auto-loaded plugin skill never recovered E assert 'policy-skill' in [] ERROR openhands.sdk.git.utils:utils.py:108 Git command failed: git clone --depth 1 http://127.0.0.1:39993/market.git ... Exit code: 128. Stderr: ... fatal: unable to access 'http://127.0.0.1:39993/market.git/': The requested URL returned error: 503 1 failed ``` `git requests after the host recovered: 0` shows that the later messages never contacted the marketplace again. The git `503` appears only in the server log. The user-facing detail does not include it. Control: with `upstream_down` set to `False` from the start, the same test passes. The output is `skills: ['policy-skill']` and a `hook_config` with the plugin's `PreToolUse` hook. ## Expected behavior - A transient fetch failure (HTTP 5xx, connection refused or reset, timeout, DNS failure, lock timeout) is retried a bounded number of times with backoff before the marketplace is reported as failed. - If the marketplace still fails, the conversation remembers which auto-load registrations failed. A later `send_message()` / `run()` tries them again a bounded number of times. When one loads, its skills, hooks, agents and MCP servers are attached through the same merge path `load_plugin()` uses, and each hook is registered only once. - Permanent failures (404 / repository not found, authentication required, invalid manifest) are not retried. The `MarketplaceLoadError` detail includes the sanitized cause, for example the last line of git's stderr with credentials redacted, so the user can tell "try again" from "fix the source". ## Suggested fix 1. Keep the failure reason. Do not turn `GitCommandError` into `None` in `try_cached_clone_or_update`. Either let it propagate to `_fetch_remote_source_with_resolution` and chain it (`raise ExtensionFetchError(...) from err`), or return a typed result. Then add a small `is_transient` classification based on git's stderr and exit code, or on the lock `Timeout`. 2. Add a bounded retry (for example 3 attempts with exponential backoff and jitter) around the clone in `_fetch_remote_source_with_resolution` (or `MarketplaceRegistry._fetch_marketplace`). Apply it only to transient errors. 3. In `_ensure_plugins_loaded`, record the auto-load registrations that still failed instead of only calling `continue`. On the next `send_message()` / `run()`, try them again (bounded) and merge the results with the existing runtime path (`_merge_runtime_plugin_hooks`, `add_skills_to`, `add_mcp_config_to`, `register_plugin_agents`). Do not re-run the whole loader, because that would register explicit and ambient hooks a second time. 4. Put the sanitized cause into the `MarketplaceLoadError` detail. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] With a git host that answers 503 once and then serves the repo, a conversation with an `auto_load` marketplace ends up with the marketplace's plugin skills and hooks attached, and emits no `MarketplaceLoadError` (recovered by the bounded retry). - [ ] With a git host that stays down during the first `send_message()` and comes back before a later `send_message()`/`run()`, the capabilities are attached on that later call. `state.hook_config` contains each plugin hook exactly once. Explicit (`hook_config=`) and ambient-plugin hooks are not duplicated. - [ ] A permanent failure (404 / repository not found) is not retried. The `MarketplaceLoadError` detail says why, with credentials redacted. - [ ] Explicitly attached plugins keep their current fail-loud behavior. --- ## OpenHands AI triage **The following comments and acceptance criteria were added by the OpenHands AI agent.** ### Triage Verified against `main` at af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b: `LocalConversation._ensure_plugins_loaded()` sets `_plugins_loaded` unconditionally and skips a failed auto-load marketplace with no record of the failure, and the fetch path makes a single `git clone` attempt while converting `GitCommandError` / lock `Timeout` into a cause-less `ExtensionFetchError` — so transient (HTTP 5xx, connection refused/reset, timeout, DNS, lock timeout) and permanent (404, authentication required, invalid manifest) failures are indistinguishable and never retried during the conversation's lifetime. The reproduction with a real git smart-HTTP server (no SDK mocks) is consistent with this. Bounded scope: preserve the git failure cause through the fetch chain; classify fetch failures as transient or permanent; retry transient failures a bounded number of times with backoff during the load attempt; remember still-failed auto-load registrations for the life of the `LocalConversation` and retry them on a later `send_message()` / `run()`, attaching recovered skills, hooks, agents and MCP servers through the existing runtime merge path (`add_skills_to`, `add_mcp_config_to`, `register_plugin_agents`, `_merge_runtime_plugin_hooks`) so each hook is registered exactly once; include the sanitized cause in the `MarketplaceLoadError` detail using the existing redaction utilities (`redact_url_credentials` / `redact_url_credentials_in_text`) rather than a new redaction implementation. Non-goals: the fail-loud behavior of explicitly attached plugins (`plugins=[...]`, `load_plugin()`) is unchanged; no unbounded or background retry loop and no retry scheduling between runs; no persistence of failed-marketplace state across process restarts (a new conversation retries naturally on load); no change to the warm-cache fallback in `_try_fetch`; the separate auto-loaded-plugin-spec `PluginLoadError` path is out of scope. ### Acceptance Criteria - [ ] With a git host that answers 503 to the first clone attempt and then serves the repository, a conversation with an `auto_load` marketplace ends with the marketplace's plugin skills in `agent_context.skills` and its hooks in `state.hook_config`, and emits no `MarketplaceLoadError` (transient failure recovered by the bounded retry). - [ ] With a git host that stays unavailable through the first `send_message()` / `run()` and becomes available before a later one, the later call re-fetches the failed auto-load registration and attaches its skills, hooks, agents and MCP servers; `state.hook_config` contains each marketplace hook exactly once, and hooks already present from an explicit `hook_config=` are not duplicated. - [ ] A still-failing auto-load marketplace is re-attempted on later `send_message()` / `run()` calls a bounded number of times per call rather than indefinitely (observable as a finite number of fetch requests per call at the git host while it stays down). - [ ] A permanent failure (404 / repository not found) is not retried: after the initial `MarketplaceLoadError`, later `send_message()` / `run()` calls make no further fetch attempts for that registration and do not re-emit the error. - [ ] The `MarketplaceLoadError` detail includes the sanitized underlying cause (for example the last line of git's stderr) with credentials redacted via the existing redaction utilities, so transient and permanent failures are distinguishable from the message. - [ ] Explicitly attached plugins keep their current fail-loud behavior: a plugin that cannot load still raises from `send_message()` / `run()` initialization. - [ ] Automated tests cover the recovered-transient, still-failing-then-recovered, permanent-failure and hook-deduplication behaviors by exercising the real fetch path (for example a local git HTTP server), without mocking SDK internals.
